scope: Read-only current Owner metadata visibility for the separate pasted-text capacity/completion ledger, including held work and a completed save whose reply was lost. No student text or other private identity is returned; no mutation/retry/release is added.

historical_fixture_run.cause: Unpaused fixture tried to resume held work; foreign-namespace fixture tried to inspect private leases as the authenticated Owner. Corrected setup order/private fixture role without weakening runtime protections.

cross_role_assessment: Only current platform_owner can read bounded opaque task metadata. Ten other role categories are denied in SQL cases; ordinary management roles remain hidden in the panel. No student-access override, public demo control or per-role dashboard tool is introduced.
verified: Actual source-bound text admission/hold/completion functions seed the synthetic tests. Active and held tasks reserve one unit; a completed-save receipt is visible by exact operation and reserves zero.
Foreign file-work IDs cannot inspect a different ledger; responses carry an explicit attached_text namespace and strict schemas reject private identifiers/content and provider/release claims.
Owner authorization reuses the transaction-held current-role proof. Unknown responses use safe messages and one read only, with no generation/retry/release path.
The panel fetches task metadata only deliberately, hides other roles, clears data on errors, ignores departed-viewer responses and does not interpret an empty list as provider cessation.

Review-only proposal41 adds three read functions without changing prior public routines, ledger/control data, raw ledger grants or private recovery authority. Native concurrency/full-schema verification is still pending.
